Own only method/test-family/multiple-testing fields; do not define S03 overlap, cluster, endogeneity, event CV, universe PIT audit, capacity, impact, regime or reconciliation fields.
EventStudyMethodSpec must expose estimation_window, event_window, normal_return_model, return_horizon, CAR/BHAR/calendar-time method slots and method_ref or n/a_reason.

multiple_testing_or_data_snooping_slot must expose family_id, tested_window_count, correction_method, adjusted_p_value, status and report_ref or n/a_reason.
Missing method evidence, test family slots, multiple-testing slot, invalid p-values or report_ref/n/a_reason both empty are BLOCKED.
